item.title: 2026 Election Insights: Candidates’ Views on Key Policies in Tokyo 12
item.description: In the run-up to the 2026 elections, candidates in Tokyo’s 12th district have expressed their views on pivotal issues such as nuclear energy policy and the introduction of a selective couple surname system. A survey conducted by Tokyo Shimbun on February 8, coinciding with the election voting day, aimed to reveal the candidates’ positions on five pressing questions that matter to voters.
